svg.text: Material 3 • React 19 + TypeScript + Vite • ESP32-S3 local web app
Fridge temperature is above the high limit
LCD. No buttons or touch required.
Examples are illustrative. Live measurements update every 5s; persisted history uses 5-minute avg/min/max buckets.
Dashboard and mobile views share one API; settings and Wi-Fi provisioning live entirely in the browser. SVG is fully editable.
